The '''Lusdu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was located one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] from the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] via [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] visited the system, orbiting the main [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system.<ref name="GA" />
